note: Original narration written for this fan project. No film dialogue, crawl text, or actor imitation.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: A galactic civil war burns across ten thousand worlds.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: In the shadow of a broken peace, the Empire has finished a station large enough to break a planet apart.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Rebel agents stole its design, and ran.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Above the desert world of Tatooine, a stolen secret races through the dark.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: This is the hour the war turns, and almost no one alive will know it happened.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Tatooine. Twin suns, endless sand, and nothing an empire would bother to want.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Which is exactly why the plans were brought here.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Inside a battered diplomatic ship, a princess carries the design of a weapon powerful enough to silence an entire world.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: For a few more seconds, the sky above her is empty.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Her corvette runs with every engine open.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The dark behind her is not empty.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: A shadow climbs into the frame. Wedge shaped, gray, and vast. An Imperial destroyer, a city of guns, hunting a single courier.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Turbolasers reach across the gap with a lag you can watch.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Shields flare, hold, and begin to fail.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Hull plating tears away. The corvette answers with the few guns she carries, and it changes nothing.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: There is no outrunning something that size. There is only the time it buys.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: And time is exactly what the princess needs.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Her engines die.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The great ship draws alongside and takes up the whole of the sky.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Magnetic clamps close. A boarding ring seals against rebel steel.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Whatever happens now, happens inside.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Somewhere in the corridors ahead, a plan is already moving.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Inside, the corridor lights turn red.

cues.speaker: REBEL OFFICER
cues.text: Hold this line. Nothing gets past us to the archive.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: They know exactly what is coming through that door, and they hold the line anyway.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The seal glows. The metal bends.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: White armor floods the passage. The fight is short, and it is never close.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Then the shooting stops.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: And something worse steps through the smoke.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: A figure in black, breathing through a machine. The Empire keeps him for problems it cannot solve with soldiers.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: He has come for the thing that was stolen.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Two decks away, the princess is working faster than a boarding party can walk.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The stolen schematics fold down into a small astromech droid. Every tower, every corridor, and one flaw at the heart of it.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: With them she records a message she may not live to send.

cues.speaker: PRINCESS
cues.text: You are carrying more than a message. Get it to the surface. Do not stop for me.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: A weapon's blueprint and a call for help, hidden inside a machine nobody thinks to search.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Two droids run for the launch bays. One of them is certain.

cues.speaker: PROTOCOL DROID
cues.text: That is not a lifeboat. That is a very small can with an engine.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: Clamps release. An unarmed pod drops away from the captured ship. No weapons, no crew, no reason to fire on it.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: On the destroyer, a gunnery officer checks for life signs, finds none, and holds his fire.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The pod falls toward the desert, a small bright point against a very old world.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The Empire will search that captured ship for hours, and find nothing.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: The fate of the galaxy left before they ever boarded.

cues.speaker: NARRATOR
cues.text: It is falling through a desert sky right now, inside an unarmed droid.
